convention: Favourite setups for repeat dispatch. A roster is a list of seat names (identity in ../crew/MANIFEST-crew.json, brief in the seat's dossier) and one line of shape. Teams flown from a roster are found in MANIFEST-dispatches.json by the roster field.

units.purpose: two seats critique build work, looking for project fit and footprint
